picks.name: MAC Trail Volunteer Day
picks.description: Spend a free morning giving back on the MAC Trail in Washington Park — trail care and restoration in one of the city's most-loved green spaces with Portland Parks. Tools provided; just bring gloves and good energy.

picks.name: Scrap Halloween Craft Night
picks.description: A Halloween-themed adult collage craft-n-chill at Dear Sandy (re-named "Fear Sandy" this month) — snip, glue, and get spooky with a pile of reclaimed materials. Low-key, creative, and a fun way to start the week.

picks.name: Wilkes Park Pollinator Volunteer
picks.description: Dig in at Wilkes Park's pollinator patch — a free morning planting and tending habitat for bees, butterflies, and birds with Portland Parks. A great way to make friends and build community!

picks.name: Free Intro to Argentine Tango
picks.description: No partner or experience needed — this free intro at the Baker Building walks you through the basics of Argentine tango. Come curious, leave dancing.

picks.name: Four Soups on Wednesdays
picks.description: Annam VL's cozy midweek ritual: four rotating soups, ladled up warm and cheap. If you haven't gotten soup from the VL restaurants, you really must. Plus it's soup season — you've no excuse.

picks.name: Three Acts at Dream House Bar
picks.description: Ms. Daniels, Hell Nancy, and Spuds Spuds Spuds take over Dream House Bar for a free night of live music in one of Portland's more unique venues (spoiler: it's a house — but one with a fun layout, I swear!).

picks.name: Trees For All Tour
picks.description: A free guided tour of Hoyt Arboretum — wander among towering specimens from around the world and hear the stories behind them. Peak-foliage timing makes it extra gorgeous.

picks.name: Halloween Costume Party
picks.description: Shanghai Tunnel's Halloween costume party brings live music and a dim basement-bar vibe to a crowd in full costume. This is your chance to test-drive that Halloween costume you're itching to put on but don't want to wait.

picks.name: Dead Media Haunted House
picks.description: A free, family-friendly haunted house inside Dead Media, the beloved NE Fremont video-rental shop — part spooky walkthrough, part love letter to VHS horror. Delightfully DIY, and totally free.

picks.name: Onesie Rave
picks.description: Exactly what it sounds like: a rave where the dress code is your coziest onesie. Cultura PDX brings the beats; you bring the fleece.

picks.name: Howloween at the Oregon Zoo
picks.description: The Oregon Zoo's beloved Howloween returns — costumes, candy stations, animals squashing pumpkins, and not-too-spooky fun for the whole family among the animals. A Portland October tradition.

picks.name: The Princess Bride in Concert
picks.description: The Oregon Symphony plays Mark Knopfler's score live to a big-screen showing of the 40th-anniversary cult classic at the Schnitz. Fencing, fighting, true love, and a full orchestra — inconceivably good.

picks.name: West Coast Giant Pumpkin Regatta
picks.description: Yes, really: giant hollowed-out pumpkins paddled across the pond at Tualatin Commons. Free, absurd, and the most Oregon thing you'll see all fall — plus a harvest festival on shore.

picks.name: The Crow Ride
picks.description: A magical year-five tradition: a family-friendly bike ride that follows Portland's winter crows — flocks of 40,000 to 70,000 — to their roost near the waterfront. Eerie, beautiful, and free to join.
